procedureRules.title: Runtime command execution flow
procedureRules.rationale: Runtime execution syscalls can execute attacker-controlled commands in server contexts.

procedureRules.title: Runtime network interaction flow
procedureRules.rationale: Observed network syscalls indicate remote reachability or data exfiltration vectors.

procedureRules.title: Runtime privilege/control flow
procedureRules.rationale: Privilege and process-control syscalls can increase impact if abused.

procedureRules.title: Runtime policy violation flow
procedureRules.rationale: Seccomp denials show attempted restricted behavior needing immediate review.

procedureRules.title: Runtime persistent execution flow
procedureRules.rationale: Timeouts indicate long-lived behavior that may hide loops or persistence attempts.
